title: "I don't know what to put on my resume."
description:
You know what you're good at in your industry and THAT'S what needs to go on your resume. It's easily to talk about your skillset and value in a conversation but that's the same information that you can turn into a resume achievement. Start by looking at the job description, see what the responsibilities are, and where you align in experience go from there. #resumetips #resume #jobsearch #jobseeker #jobsearchtips

transcript: you ever feel like you could just guarantee a job if you could skip the application and go talk to someone I wish that was the case unfortunately it's not but that is how you can think about what you put on your resume this isn't a place for responsibilities this is where you want to show that value so think about what you would tell somebody what skills do you have and how you use them if you go to the responsibilities of a job description that's what's going on for the day-to-day and where you align and experience that value that you know you have turn that into an achievement and that's what goes on your resume
